missionPremise: A-035 (OPS-16, 2026-08-26) opened P-88 and ruled vendor directory listings happen only after a live Claude Connect probe. P-87 shipped, so the probe is satisfiable. The commercial premise, from the card and the dispatch: Claude Sync is the only channel Smart Site has that a competitor cannot simply buy, and today the connector is a reason to buy and a reason to stay but not a way to be found. _decisions/2026-08-31_smartsite_connector_is_a_door_not_a_tier.md fixes the tier story: the connector is a door available at every rung including Free, mirroring workbench gates rather than carrying its own.
completionPredicate: A stranger reading the prepared listing can decide whether Smart Site is for them, connect it, and reach a first useful answer, and every capability sentence in that listing maps to a tool that is live AND functional in production at the tier the sentence implies. This lane is complete when the submission text exists verbatim, every sentence has a named provenance in _smartsite_masters/ or a live probe, the claim-to-tool-to-gate table is filled from live state, and every blocker standing between the prepared text and an actual filing is named with its owner.
scopeBasis: IN: prepare the listing text and the submission field pack; probe the connector; map claims to live tools and gates; name the staleness mechanism or its absence. OUT and deliberately so: (a) actual submission, because this lane's dispatch forbids submitting to any external directory or vendor, so card item 5 CANNOT be closed here and is handed back; (b) any change to a tool, a tool name, or a gate, forbidden by the card's 'explicitly not this card'; (c) GPT store, SEO parcel pages, Zapier, all named not-carded by A-035; (d) new positioning claims, forbidden by card item 4; (e) writing to any product repo, per ENFORCEMENT 'stay in your own repositories'.

findings.title: export_instrument is NOT live in production. The functional count is 9 of 13, not 13 and not 10.
findings.evidence: Live call returned status not_ready with reason 'Hauska MCP export proxy not configured' at 2026-09-02T21:40Z. At source, legacy-design-tools main 7217621, tools.ts: the export_instrument handler runs `if (!loadHauskaMcpConfig()) { return notReadyMessage(...) }` immediately after the studio gate.
findings.mechanism: The deployed revision smartsite-mcp-00085-nuj carries no Hauska MCP proxy configuration, so loadHauskaMcpConfig() returns null and the tool refuses before it ever proxies.
findings.alternativeMechanismRejected: Alternative: the probing account lacks Studio and the studio gate produced this. REJECTED on three independent grounds. (1) kind 'brief' is not in STUDIO_EXPORT_KINDS, which is [siteplan, terrain, dossier], so the studio gate does not apply to the call that was made. (2) The studio refusal has a different shape, status upgrade_required with reason studio_report, not status not_ready. (3) The same account successfully ran get_smart_site at depth node and run_report, both of which the product's own disclosure gates on a paid rung, so the account is paid.
contradicts: This dispatch's ground-truth block, '13 tools are live'. Nine are.

The deployed https://mcp.smartsite.cloud/llms.txt, which presents export_instrument as available and promises it 'returns degraded (not server-down) if Hauska is unreachable'. Production returns not_ready, a third state, and the cause is unconfigured rather than unreachable.
_inbox/2026-08-28_p88_item21_directory_blockers.md item B2, which recorded export_instrument as live and rewrote the submission copy on that basis.
findings.consequenceForListing: The entire export story, site plan CAD, terrain, dossier and brief artifact, must be absent from the listing. This removes the Studio-deliverable half of the connector pitch. Naming it would be exactly the defect class card item 2 forbids.

Verbatim: 'Organization settings aren't available on individual plans.'
findings.consequence: If the Empressa / Legacy Group ATX Claude account is an individual plan, P-88 cannot be filed at all until that changes, however good the copy is. A-035 never named this precondition and the 2026-08-28 draft never checked it. Operator-owned; this lane cannot see the account plan.

findings.title: There is no documentation page, and the Listing step requires a Documentation URL.
findings.evidence: https://smartsite.cloud/docs, /help, /support, /connect, /ai, /use-in-your-ai, /connectors, /mcp and /about all return the 1215-byte SPA shell, byte-identical to /. findings.title: Coverage: the masters say say nationwide, the dispatch says never nationwide, and the running product says Central Texas.
findings.mastersSay: _smartsite_masters/00_README.md: 'Coverage is spoken of as nationwide United States (operator, 2026-08-04).' _smartsite_masters/06: 'Collateral speaks of coverage as nationwide United States.' and 'What collateral must not do is enumerate specific counties as the extent of coverage.' _smartsite_masters/08: 'Speak of coverage as nationwide United States.'
findings.dispatchSays: 'Coverage is SIX Central Texas counties. Never statewide, never nationwide.'
findings.productSays: Three independent live derivations, all 2026-09-02. (1) mcp.smartsite.cloud/llms.txt, find_parcel: 'candidate parcels from county parcel records in Central Texas coverage.' (2) The identical string in the tool schema a connected client actually receives. (3) smartsite.cloud/manifest.webmanifest description: 'Explore Central Texas parcels'.
findings.traceability: The six counties are traceable to a tracked doc, so naming them is not a fresh claim: _smartsite_gtm/01_central_texas_gtm_strategy.md, 'Operationally Central Texas is the six counties running the conformant serving shape: Bastrop 48021, Travis 48453, Williamson 48491, Hays 48209, Caldwell 48055, and McLennan 48309.'
findings.resolutionApplied: The prepared copy says Central Texas, names the six counties, and never says statewide or nationwide. Reasoning: a directory listing is a capability claim made to strangers who will test it against their own parcel, and the narrower claim cannot be caught out while the wider one can. The masters' own retirement of 'confirmed on request' (06, 2026-08-10) requires the coverage answer to be self-serve, which argues for telling a reader plainly rather than making them ask.
findings.ruleNeeded: One operator line. Does the six-county enumeration override the masters' non-enumeration rule for the directory surface specifically, or does the listing use the unenumerated form 'Central Texas coverage' in the server's own words? Both variants are supplied. Recommend the enumerated one.
findings.secondaryFinding: _smartsite_masters/08 still tells a reader that a buyer's jurisdiction 'can be confirmed on request', which _smartsite_masters/06 explicitly RETIRED on 2026-08-10 for putting a human into a humanless loop. Both files carry last_updated 2026-08-27. Two masters, one contradiction. Not this lane's to fix; recorded for the masters owner.

findings.title: There are three effective gates, not the two the connector ruling counted, and one is not in the MCP layer at all.
findings.evidence: MCP-layer gates in tools.ts are exactly two: run_report requires canRunDeepReport, paid at any rung, and export_instrument requires canRunStudioReport, studio or team, when kind is siteplan, terrain or dossier. get_smart_site carries NO MCP-layer gate but passes auth.userId to cortex, and the deployed disclosure says it 'Requires Solo or above, or a 30-day unlock on that parcel; otherwise returns refused with reason upgrade_required'.
findings.reconciliation: Not a contradiction. _decisions/2026-08-31_smartsite_connector_is_a_door_not_a_tier.md counted MCP-layer gate points; the third gate is enforced downstream in cortex on the shared workbench path, which is precisely the one-gate-two-doors design that ruling protects. Recorded because the ruling's sentence 'eleven of thirteen tools require only an authenticated account' reads as a product-wide coverage claim and is only true of the MCP layer.
findings.notVerified: This lane did NOT observe the free-tier refusal. It ran on a paid account and watched the paths succeed. The listing states the gate in the product's own words; whether a free account actually receives upgrade_required on get_smart_site is unprobed and needs a free account to establish.
findings.sideFinding: export_instrument with kind 'brief' passes through no entitlement gate at all in the MCP layer, since brief is not a STUDIO_EXPORT_KIND and there is no paid check on that path. Moot today because F1 refuses the whole tool, but it becomes a live ungated paid-capability path the moment the Hauska proxy is configured.

adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.challenge: The dispatch handed me a ground-truth block and told me not to re-derive it. I re-derived one line of it and it was wrong.
adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.resolution: '13 tools are live' is false; nine are functional. The dispatch's other ground truths held: health 200, POST /mcp 401 rather than a 5xx, warm latency, llms.txt serving three formats, the connector as a door. Reporting a planner figure as wrong is a successful outcome per DEV_PROCESS 3.2, and this one would otherwise have put a dead capability into a public listing.

adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.challenge: Am I treating an unauthenticated discovery chain as if it were the cold-connect probe card item 1 demands?
adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.resolution: No, and the close says so plainly. What is proven cold is the whole pre-authorization handshake performed by a client holding nothing: a 401 carrying the RFC 9728 resource_metadata pointer, then protected-resource metadata, then authorization-server metadata with S256 PKCE. What is NOT proven is a browser OAuth consent by an account that has never authorized Smart Site, followed by a first tool call. My tool calls ran through an already-authorized connector, which card item 1 explicitly rules out. Item 1 is PARTIAL and needs a human at a browser with a fresh account.

adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.challenge: Convenient results. Every document I read supported the listing being nearly ready.
adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.resolution: The one instrument pointed at the product rather than at a document, a single export_instrument call, falsified the dispatch, the deployed capability disclosure and the prior lane's close simultaneously. That is ENFORCEMENT's 'code reading outranks output measuring' landing in the other direction as well: the documents all agreed with each other and were all wrong. It is why F6 is four tools and not three.

adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.challenge: Should this lane write copy at all, given item 4 says claims come from the masters and never from the card?
adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.resolution: Yes, but every sentence is traced, and the submission pack carries per-sentence provenance. Three sentences could not be traced to a master and are flagged rather than shipped quietly: the six-county enumeration (F7), the property-intelligence-report naming (F8), and the honesty-vocabulary sentence, which is traced to the live wire vocabulary rather than to a master because the master's phrase 'not verified' is not a string the connector actually returns.

adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.challenge: Is the six-county coverage line itself measured, or am I repeating a doc?
adversarialReviewOfOwnPlan.resolution: Repeating a doc, and saying so. _smartsite_gtm/01 states the six counties and, in the same section, that they are NOT county-complete: 232,770 parcels unstamped and Travis carrying 119,389 rows with no situs row as of the 2026-08-30 measurement, with an explicit instruction to re-measure before external use. This lane did NOT re-measure. The copy therefore names no count and no completeness, only the counties plus the honest-absence behavior, which is the form that survives without a fresh measurement.
